modules.title: Clinical Documentation & Technical Writing Standards (MTC™ Compliance Module)
modules.title_ar: معايير التوثيق السريري والكتابة الطبية الاحترافية (وحدة الامتثال MTC™)
modules.focus: Mandatory quality assurance training to eradicate tenfold dosing errors, decimal tracking failures, SI unit mislabeling, and binomial nomenclature collisions.

syllabus.rationale: Historical board exam recalls (such as SMC RAW datasets) demonstrate that a critical percentage of medical errors stem not from diagnostic miscalculations, but from systemic communication breakdowns. Mislabeled SI units, trailing/missing decimal points, unstandardized abbreviations, and incorrect binomial nomenclature introduce fatal vulnerabilities into patient charts and research manuscripts.
objectives: Master SI Unit Integrity: Eliminate tenfold dosing errors by enforcing strict metric standards (proper spacing, leading zeros for decimals, correct unit formatting).
Enforce Taxonomic & Nosological Precision: Apply official glossary guidelines and italicized binomial nomenclature to prevent data collisions.
Optimize Electronic Health Record (EHR) Safety: Draft unambiguous admission notes, surgical sign-outs, and transfer summaries.
Streamline Research Reporting: Align clinical case reports and academic manuscripts with international journal publishing standards.

units.unit: Unit 1: The Anatomy of a Medical Error in Documentation
topics: Typography as a clinical safety tool
Hazards of 'The Clinic Way' vs standardized medical writing
Case studies on decimal point failures and unit mislabeling

units.unit: Unit 2: SI Unit Regulations & Prescription Safety
topics: Rules for dosing notation (avoiding dangerous abbreviations like U or IU)
Safe handling of electrolytes, chemotherapy orders, and continuous infusion rates

units.unit: Unit 3: Nosology, Terminology, and Data Harmonization
topics: Eliminating synonymous jargon and aligning with the unified glossary
Correct formatting of disease entities, syndromes, and pharmacological agents

units.unit: Unit 4: Institutional Auditing & MTC™ Forensic Review
topics: Implementing the MTC™ framework for self-auditing clinical logs
Preparing error-free handover notes and discharge letters (Arztbrief adaptation)

assessment.formative: Weekly technical writing practical audits correcting intentionally flawed patient charts and prescription logs.
assessment.summative: Comprehensive 3-hour forensic document sanitization exam correcting SI, formatting, and structural errors within a simulated hospital database.
